editorial:
Imagine moving to Los Angeles with a big dream and a bright smile, only to find out that the city has a very dark side. You follow a group of girls who are ready to do whatever it takes to make it big in Hollywood. They are young, hopeful, and a bit naive about how the world works. The vibe starts off like a classic success story, but it quickly turns into a nightmare. You feel the tension build as these girls realize that some people in the industry are not looking for talent, but are actually looking for victims. It is a scary look at the dangers of chasing fame in a place where people disappear without a trace.

The acting feels very real, which makes the scary parts hit way harder. While the middle of the movie slows down a bit, the twists keep you guessing until the end. If you like thrillers that show the ugly side of glamour, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking reveal that the girls were lured into a trap by someone they trusted. You see that the dream of stardom was just a lie to get them alone on Mulholland Drive. One girl manages to fight back in a desperate struggle for survival, but the cycle of violence continues. It wraps up by showing that the city consumes young souls, leaving a grim warning about the cost of fame.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark stories about the price of fame.
